title: Boniello Development Corp
description:
Spanning four generations the Boniello family has built over 400 homes of outstanding quality and genuine beauty, giving them the reputation as the finest builders and developers in our area.  

From inception, every detail is carefully monitored to ensure the finest community of homes possible, including site plan development, road construction, architectural design and construction of every home.

Indian Hill in Goldens Bridge, Primrose Farms, The Woodlot and Twin Knolls in Somers, as well as Katonah Crossings in Katonah are just some of the communities that have been completed.
author: Houlihan Lawrence
